input.title: Ram and Sita
input.story:
"Ram and Sita are walking through the forest. Sita looks worried.
Ram says, 'Sita, do not worry. I am with you.'
Sita looks at Ram and says, 'I know Ram, but this forest feels strange.'
Suddenly Shyam arrives and says, 'Ram! Sita! You must leave immediately.'"
